title: Stairway to Heaven
composer: Jimmy Page & Robert Plant / Led Zeppelin
description: The unmistakable right-hand guitar arpeggio intro and the iconic vocal melody ("There's a lady who's sure").
generalTip: Focus on the right hand. The intro climbs through chord arpeggios (a -> b -> c' -> d'), followed by Robert Plant's timeless verse melody.

sections.label: The Iconic Arpeggio
tips: 🪜 The legendary acoustic opening — listen for the top note climbing: A -> B -> C -> D!
🖤 ^g is G# (black key) and ^f is F# (black key) — these give the arpeggio its mysterious beauty
👆 Finger guide: start with Finger 1 on A, roll through c(2) e(3) to high a(5)

sections.label: The Resolution
tips: 🍃 The descending return: high c' -> b -> a settling softly on home note A
🎵 Feel the tension release as the phrase rolls down through F and G chords
🔄 Put Sections 1 and 2 together to play the world's most famous rock intro!
